scripts.check: deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/dataframe && deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/shims && deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/mcp && deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/examples/dataframe && deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/testing/bugs && deno run -A scripts/parse-check.ts --unstable-tsgo packages/testing/statistical_tests
scripts.ci: pnpm fmt && pnpm lint && pnpm check && deno test -A --parallel --v8-flags=--max-old-space-size=8192 packages/dataframe packages/examples/dataframe packages/testing/bugs packages/testing/statistical_tests --quiet
scripts.ci:shims: deno fmt packages/shims && deno lint packages/shims && deno test -A packages/shims
scripts.ci:no-stats: pnpm fmt && pnpm lint && deno check --unstable-tsgo packages/dataframe && deno check --unstable-tsgo packages/examples/dataframe && deno check --unstable-tsgo packages/testing/bugs && deno check --unstable-tsgo packages/testing/new_features && deno test -A --parallel packages/dataframe packages/examples/dataframe packages/testing/bugs packages/testing/new_features --quiet
scripts.benchmark:runner: cd packages/testing/benchmarks && deno run -A runner.ts && cd ../..
scripts.benchmark:analyze: cd packages/testing/benchmarks && deno run -A analyze.ts && cd ../..
scripts.wasmbuild: deno run -A scripts/parse-build.ts Building WASM -- deno run -A jsr:@deno/wasmbuild@0.21.1 --features wasm --out packages/dataframe/lib
scripts.napibuild: deno run -A scripts/parse-build.ts Building native addon -- sh -c 'cargo build --features napi-rs --release && cp target/release/libtidy_ts_dataframe.dylib packages/dataframe/lib/tidy_ts_dataframe.darwin-arm64.node && cp target/release/libtidy_ts_dataframe.dylib packages/npm-darwin-arm64/tidy_ts_dataframe.darwin-arm64.node'
scripts.napibuild:debug: deno run -A scripts/parse-build.ts Building native addon [debug] -- sh -c 'cargo build --features napi-rs && cp target/debug/libtidy_ts_dataframe.dylib packages/dataframe/lib/tidy_ts_dataframe.darwin-arm64.node && cp target/debug/libtidy_ts_dataframe.dylib packages/npm-darwin-arm64/tidy_ts_dataframe.darwin-arm64.node'
scripts.napibuild:win32-x64: deno run -A scripts/parse-build.ts Building native addon [win32-x64] -- sh -c 'cargo xwin build --features napi-rs --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && cp target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/tidy_ts_dataframe.dll packages/npm-win32-x64/tidy_ts_dataframe.win32-x64.node'
scripts.build:npm: deno run -A scripts/build-shims-npm.ts && deno run -A scripts/build-dataframe-npm.ts
scripts.pack:npm: cd packages/shims/dist && npm pack && cd ../../dataframe/dist && npm pack && cd ../../npm-darwin-arm64 && npm pack && cd ../npm-win32-x64 && npm pack
scripts.publish:dataframe:npm:darwin-arm64: cp packages/dataframe/lib/tidy_ts_dataframe.darwin-arm64.node packages/npm-darwin-arm64/ && cd packages/npm-darwin-arm64 && pnpm publish --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:all:npm: pnpm publish:shims:npm && pnpm publish:dataframe:npm:darwin-arm64 && pnpm publish:dataframe:npm:win32-x64 && pnpm publish:dataframe:npm
scripts.docs:prerender: cd packages/docs && bun run prerender && cd ../..
scripts.joss:render: cd joss && docker run --rm --volume "$PWD:/data" --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --env JOURNAL=joss openjournals/inara
